name: ANS REWIRE
founded_year_range: 2016 (FAQ: 'Launched in 2016'; site copyright from 2016; earliest Wayback snapshot reported as Mar 2016). The precursor book CFS Unravelled is dated c. 2013, which is unverified. The recovery story was on Health Rising by Aug 25 2015 (verified).
cost_summary: AUD 537 (approx. USD 374) for 12 months' access, per the program-details page (verified Oct 2026). Optional 1:1 coaching at AUD 139/hr, generally offered only after the course. Free intro lessons, podcast and blog.
mechanisms: autonomic/nervous system dysregulation (sympathetic overdrive, "stuck in fight-or-flight")
limbic system impairment / amygdala threat conditioning
mechanism_summary: A physical plus psychological stressor (infection, vaccination, surgery, childbirth, life stress) leaves the ANS stuck in sympathetic "survival mode." Central sensitisation and a conditioned threat response keep it there. This produces secondary dysfunctions (mitochondrial, endocrine, gut, immune or infection, methylation, neurotransmitter), which in turn act as physical triggers that close a vicious loop. The Science page presents ME/CFS (including PVFS and 'adrenal fatigue'), PVFS-type long COVID, fibromyalgia, POTS, MCS, EHS and IBS as one illness. It puts SSD, FND and CRPS on the same spectrum and treats chronic Lyme and mould as secondary infections or triggers.
techniques: REWIRE technique (interrupt trigger response, reframe, redirect attention)
sleep hygiene and sleep relaxation audio
optional integrative-medicine adjuncts (metabolic, hormonal, detox support)
mainstream_notes: No health-system, guideline or hospital adoption. Endorsed on the site by individual practitioners (Prof. Kati Thieme; Dr. Jacob Teitelbaum). Promoted through Health Rising and long-COVID podcasts. The founder is a lay person, not a clinician.
insurance_notes: Direct-to-consumer purchase. No billing pathway, no clinician delivery, and the site does not mention insurers.
controversy: There are no outcome data. The FAQ argues placebo-controlled trials are unsuitable for a personalised program and declines to give a success rate. Correlational dysautonomia studies (Allen 2012, Stewart 1998, De Becker 1998, Naschitz 2004, Martinez-Martinez 2014) are cited as if causal. Heterogeneous conditions are lumped together, including 'adrenal fatigue', which endocrinology does not recognise, plus 'chronic Lyme' and mould illness. Adjuncts include brainwave entrainment and detox. The founder has no clinical credentials. It draws the usual ME/CFS advocate objections to brain-retraining programs, which Neuffer counters with a hybrid physical-loop model.

indicators.value: March 2016 (as reported by researcher; Wayback not re-checkable at fact-check)
Health Rising recovery story published Aug 25 2015
Ongoing Dan Neuffer podcast; guest on Long Covid Podcast

popularity.reach_estimate: Roughly 10^4 people. Paid participants are probably in the low thousands to about 10k; book, podcast and blog audiences perhaps several tens of thousands.
popularity.method_notes: Trajectory anchored on documented dates: Health Rising feature in 2015, 2016 launch, and the 2020-22 long-COVID pivot with podcast appearances. Book dates (c. 2013, 2017 edition) are unverified. Scaled by the site's own claim of 'thousands' in 60+ countries. Reddit and Google Trends were not checked because the search budget was exhausted. Reach is a rough order-of-magnitude guess.
